desc: Static no-rig audit of the a1-controller access boundary isolated by ticket 305 run 5: Linux hard-stalls on its first MMIO to ADT-derived 0x309198000 while the July m1n1 hpm2 path worked and the rollback-proxy exception is explicitly inconclusive. Grounding: NEXT_STEPS §6 and ticket 305. Compare the captured ADT reg/size and generation, Linux DT resource plus ioremap attributes, and the exact July-proven versus rollback m1n1 MMU mappings/MAIR; prove each VA-to-PA translation and artifact hash. Deliver an evidence table and a verdict distinguishing unmapped object, size/attribute mismatch, or a genuinely mapped hardware stall. Offline only: no MMIO access, no guessed offsets, and no hardware or firmware write. Feed tickets 1000 and 1002.
